```yaml
name: Advanced Translation Check

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  advanced-translation-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v2
      with:
        python-version: '3.x'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install translate-toolkit msgfmt

    - name: Run translate-toolkit checks
      run: |
        pofilter --check variables prices.openfoodfacts.org urls --po .github/i18n/*.po

    - name: Run custom translation checks
      run: |
        python .github/scripts/advanced_translation_check.py .github/i18n/*.arb

    - name: Run gettext format checks
      run: |
        find .github/i18n -name "*.arb" -exec msgfmt -c {} \;

    - name: Upload results as artifacts
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
      with:
        name: translation-check-results
        path: .github/i18n/check_results.txt
```
